results.name: M1 open space: crouched, Shift + a direction stands you up and runs (no second C), at the ordinary run speed
results.note: crouched true; states crouch > run > stand; running 0 step(s) after Shift + direction reached the movement step; top speed 285 px/s (run 285)

results.name: M2 insufficient clearance: under low furniture with Shift held you stay low (no frame standing where a standing body does not fit); out from under it you stand and run
results.note: states crawl > crouch > run > stand; 96 steps under it, 109 low; standing without room 0; stood at (1450.1, 5040); ran after true

results.name: M3 stamina: exhausted you stay crouched with Shift held; when stamina is back (Shift still held) you stand and run
results.note: exhausted: crouch (top 86 px/s); stamina back: crouch > run > stand

results.name: M4 repeated Shift presses while crouched and moving: the first press stands you up; none crouches you again (no stand/crouch flicker)
results.note: states crouch > run > walk > run > walk > run > walk > run > walk > run > walk > run > walk > stand; crouched again after standing: 0 steps

results.name: M5 C while Shift is held crouches you and moving keeps you low; pressing Shift again stands you up and runs
results.note: C with Shift held: crouched true; moving with Shift still held: crouch; Shift pressed again: crouch > run > stand

results.name: M6 slide rules kept: run + C slides, the slide ends low for its recovery, and with Shift still held you run again after it
results.note: states stand > run > slide > crouch > run > stand; low after the slide 290 ms (recovery .32 s); ran after: true

results.name: M7 networked (server-checked player): crouch -> Shift runs; the server accepts every position (no correction) and an observing player sees crouch, then run at run speed, where the player really is
results.note: client crouch > run > stand; corrections 0; the observer saw stand > crouch > run > stand (top 278 px/s); server vs client position after 0 px
